guide.title: Try the loop in 5 minutes
guide.today: Teacher phone, Today: SATS shows Ravi (roll 4) and Rohan (roll 24) absent. Manjunath is back today.
guide.lesson: Record today's lesson in Kannada, or pick it from the list, and confirm it.
guide.evening: Tap Send messages now (in a real school this goes by itself at 6 pm). Tonight's message arrives on Rohan's family's phone, in Hindi; tap it and pick a reason.
guide.approve: Approve: generate the week's three catch-ups: Telugu for Ravi (4 lessons squeezed into 1 or 2), Kannada for Manjunath (2 days) and Hindi for Rohan (today's lesson). Listen, read the summary, tick and approve, then tap Send messages now.
guide.parent: Rohan's family's phone: open the catch-up, listen, do the activity and tap a picture.
guide.after: Teacher phone: Missed lessons shows how Rohan did; Back today has Manjunath's buddy card; Week shows return speed and reasons.
guide.calendar: The story follows the real calendar: Ravi has been away since Monday, so early in the week he has missed fewer lessons.
